title: Sarymsakov-Type Semigroups With Support Dominance and Nested Mixing Cores
summary: This note develops three multiplication-closed families of stochastic matrices for consensus under arbitrary switching. The first is a support-dominance enlargement of an earlier power-generated construction, in which exact support-pattern matching is relaxed to a dominance-type condition without losing closure under multiplication. The second is a fixed-core class with an exact uniform scrambling horizon and corresponding convergence-rate guarantees for switching products. The third and main contribution is the almost Sarymsakov class, obtained by allowing variable mixing-core dimensions…
